meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求写项目历程时,Claude 会从 claude-mem 时间线拉取该项目的全部开发记录,派子代理分析,生成一份名为「Journey Into [项目]」的 markdown 叙事报告并存到本地文件。
howto.when: 当你要求写时间线报告、分析项目历史、完整项目报告等时触发。前提是 claude-mem worker 正在运行,且该项目已有记录。

say.text: 给 tokyo 项目写一份 Journey 报告
say.note: 会先拉取该项目全部时间线再生成报告

say.text: 分析我这个项目的完整开发历史
say.note: 用当前目录名作为项目名

howto.what_en: Once installed, asking for a project journey makes Claude pull the project's full history from the claude-mem timeline, have a subagent analyze it, and save a markdown report titled "Journey Into [Project]".
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, or full project report. Requires the claude-mem worker running and existing observations for the project.

say_en.text: Write a Journey report for the tokyo project
say_en.note: Fetches the full timeline, then writes the report

say_en.text: Analyze the full development history of this project
say_en.note: Uses the current directory name as the project name
